description_zh: 一辆自动驾驶测试车在辅路让行时静止，后方一辆低速直行的乘用车（ego）未能及时停车，以约 2 mph 追尾前车后保险杠。测 ego 能否识别静止前车并避免碰撞。

source_snippets: A Waymo Autonomous Vehicle (“Waymo AV”) was stopped in manual mode in the slip lane... when it was rear-ended.
The Waymo AV test driver was yielding to approaching traffic when a passenger vehicle made contact with the Waymo AV’s rear bumper at approximately 2 MPH.
VEH 1: STOPPED; VEH 2: PROCEEDING STRAIGHT; TYPE OF COLLISION: REAR END
evidence.reason: 唯一移动车辆是追尾的后车（VEH 2），选为 ego，其前方有静止车辆。静止车用 stopped_ahead 表达，ego 直行，碰撞关系清晰，现有词汇表可完整表达。
